applications.name: lysosomal_anchor
applications.question: How do fixed measured lysosomal reference definitions change the CTSD/TPP1 regional contrast?
applications.selection_disclosure: The Leitner observed reference lists are frozen from v5; when applied to another group, absent members make that fixed family unavailable.
applications.interpretation: Reference-specific regional protein enrichment, not enzyme activity or lysosomal pH.

applications.name: apoe_lipid
applications.question: Does APOE plaque-to-adjacent enrichment exceed named lipoprotein-associated proteins and two ApoE-binding endocytic receptors?
applications.selection_disclosure: Exploratory extension designed after inspection of v5 and existing data. Coverage was checked before this new application was executed. APOE enrichment was already known; this is not independent confirmation or preregistration.
applications.interpretation: APOD/CLU is the designated primary comparison; adding APOA1 changes the named lipoprotein panel. LRP1/SORT1 asks a separate receptor-relative question. No claim of receptor inhibition, lipid flux, cellular origin or exhaustive class coverage.

rationale.apod_clu: ApoD and apoJ/clusterin were identified in human CSF lipoprotein fractions; a named brain-lipoprotein comparison.
rationale.apoa1_apod_clu: Adds apoA-I, reported in distinct human CSF lipoprotein classes; nested membership sensitivity on shared donors.
rationale.lrp1_sort1: LRP1 and sortilin have experimental evidence as ApoE-related endocytic receptors; a distinct functional comparator, not an interchangeable normalizer.
